questions.text: Think again about the situation that made you angry or annoyed. How responsible was the person/people who you were angry or annoyed at for the situation?  Think of a scale where 0 means he/she was/were not at all responsible, while 10 means he/she/they was/were completely responsible.

name: selfresp
label: How reSP. do you feel for the situation?

questions.text: How responsible do YOU feel for the situation? Think of a scale where 0 means you were not at all responsible and 10 means you were totally responsible for what happened.

name: likeoth
